judgments.note: org.md says only 'shows the policy error'; reference gate.ts reads it the same way.
org.md lists the spellings, settings-reference.md says only 'a wider set of forms'; matches the reference git-url.ts (host lower case, path keeps case).
The docs say regex matched anywhere and name no dialect.
troubleshooting.md quotes one line and 'the rejected flags'; the reference sideload.ts appends ': unset the variable'.
The docs say 'appends' and name no separator.
settings-reference.md gives the string form and no split rule; names cannot contain @.
The label list missed settings:<name> and npm:<package>, both valid policy-list and marketplace source types (reference gate.ts LABELS).

Kept the decision (list order places the guard; omitted means no guard), stated by admin.md 'follows the order you list' and its example; evidence now names events.md's default order (guard before prependPlugins mods), the reading it resolves, and agrees with §10 events.md tier table.

Kept: docs are silent on the guard in appendPlugins; evidence completed with settings-reference.md appendPlugins skipping ids that do not count as the organization's, and the reference implementation's mod-order.ts reading.

Was exactly Host, Cookie, X-Forwarded-*. Oracle 2.1.325 validate warns for 21 names (forwarded, x-real-ip, via, te, content-length...) and prefixes x-forwarded-, x-original-, proxy-, with _ read as -; same list in installed 2.1.319/2.1.322/2.1.325 builds. Docs say "such as", so it stays a judgment, now with the full set.
